# Release Notes Template

Summarize user-facing changes in Field Suite, Spatial Engine, Dispatch, and Packages, then end with release channels:

---
- **Web App**: https://sevagis.dpdns.org
- **Android APK (`seva-gis-latest.apk`)**: Auto-syncs with web via `/version.json` & `/updates/latest.json`
- **Container Package**: `docker pull ghcr.io/virahitvin8/seva-gis:main`
- **QGIS / ArcGIS Plugins**: Attached in Release Assets (`seva_gee_flow_qgis.zip`, `seva_gee_flow_arcgis.zip`)
